raw_translation: Kugusa au kuzingatia idadi na bonyeza Enter au nafasi ya alama ni nyeusi. seli zilizowekwa alama ni kuvuka nje; seli unmarked kukaa nyeupe. bodi halali ina hakuna idadi ya kurudia nyeupe katika safu yoyote au nguzo, hakuna upande-kugusa seli nyeusi, na eneo moja kushikamana nyeupe. Angalia bodi au ombi la hint wakati unahitaji msaada.
source: Tap or focus a number and press Enter or Space to mark it black. Marked cells are crossed out; unmarked cells stay white. A valid board has no repeated white number in any row or column, no side-touching black cells, and one connected white area. Check the board or request a hint when you need help.
translation: Kugusa au kuzingatia idadi na bonyeza Enter au nafasi ya alama ni nyeusi. seli zilizowekwa alama ni kuvuka nje; seli unmarked kukaa nyeupe. bodi halali ina hakuna idadi ya kurudia nyeupe katika safu yoyote au nguzo, hakuna upande-kugusa seli nyeusi, na eneo moja kushikamana nyeupe. Angalia bodi au ombi la hint wakati unahitaji msaada.

raw_translation: Hakuna kuunga mkono A-Z barua zilipatikana. idadi tarehe bado inapatikana.
source: No supported A–Z letters were found. The date numbers are still available.
